messages:
Noah (support): Heads up: customer reported 400 on POST /v1/models/deploy. Their body used `replicas: 2` (per our API ref example) but server rejects it. Error: "unknown field replicas".

Priya (docs): That sounds bad. I thought we standardized on `replica_count` last quarter. Which doc page is still using `replicas`?

Noah (support): The API reference `deploy` example under "Create deployment" (docs/api/models.yaml) still has `replicas`. Customer sent exactly the curl in the example.

Diego (eng): Confirmed: the runtime accepts either `replica_count` (int) or the newer `autoscale` object {min,max,policy}. `replicas` was removed in v2 of the model controller. OpenAPI file is out of date. Also the response example shows `id` but actual response returns `deployment_id` and 201 not 200.

Priya (docs): Ok. Plan: patch OpenAPI to show `replica_count` and include an alternate example for `autoscale` + update response example to `deployment_id` and 201. I'll draft a PR.

Lina (sdk): FYI the JS SDK wrapper accepted `replicas` as an alias — I put a deprecation warning in last release. We should add a migration note so customers know `replicas` will be removed from the SDK next minor. I'll update the snippet in docs to use `replica_count` and add the autoscale example.

Aria (product): Customer impact: medium (deploy blocked). Recommend we add a short migration blurb at top of the deploy ref and a one-liner in the changelog. Also consider a temporary compatibility layer in the controller for a week. Diego, can we do that quickly?

Diego (eng): I can add a compatibility mapper that accepts `replicas` -> `replica_count` and emits a warning in logs for one release. Will create an internal patch and add an integration test.

Priya (docs): Draft snippets — curl and Python examples to replace the old ones. Please check before I open the PR.

Priya (docs): New curl example (deployment with replica_count):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/deploy" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-medium-v2","replica_count":3,"resources":{"gpu":"a10g"}}'
```

Priya (docs): Autoscale example snippet (JSON body):
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-medium-v2",
  "autoscale": {"min":1,"max":6,"policy":"cpu"},
  "resources": {"gpu":"a10g"}
}
```

Priya (docs): Expected response example (201):
```json
{"deployment_id":"dep_01F...","status":"creating","created_at":"2026-03-10T18:41:00Z"}
```

Lina (sdk): Python example (requests):
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post(
    "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/deploy",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"model":"gpt-medium-v2","replica_count":3}
)
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```

Diego (eng): I'll add tests asserting both `replica_count` and `autoscale` accepted and that response contains `deployment_id`. Also will log warning when `replicas` key seen.

deploy-bot: Opening PR for controller compatibility shim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controller/pull/990 (draft)

Priya (docs): I've opened docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330 
- updates OpenAPI schema for /models/deploy 
- replaces example request/response 
- adds migration note about `replicas` -> `replica_count` and mentions SDK deprecation

Lina (sdk): SDK PRs queued: js-sdk/#679 will update examples and add a deprecation warning in helpers; py-sdk/#216 will adjust the convenience wrapper and add a changelog entry.

Aria (product): Good. Action items: make sure docs PR links to SDK PRs, and add a short blurb in the release notes. Also notify support and the customer once compatibility shim is live.

Priya (docs): Action list (current):
- [x] Replace `replicas` in API examples with `replica_count`
- [x] Add `autoscale` example block and note recommended usage for production
- [x] Update response example to `deployment_id` + 201
- [ ] Add migration note in deploy doc and changelog
- [ ] Link SDK PRs in docs and coordinate minor release
- [ ] Confirm controller compatibility shim merged and then remove deprecation alias one week after release

Diego (eng): Controller shim PR open and tests in CI. ETA to merge: today afternoon. Will ping this thread when merged.

deploy-bot: Controller PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controller/pull/990 (merged by Diego)

Lina (sdk): Docs PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330 (merged by Priya). Opened SDK PRs and set them to target next minor.

Noah (support): I'll follow up with the customer, provide the new snippet and timeline. Thanks all.

Priya (docs): I'll add the migration blurb to the release notes and post in #customer-updates. Closing thread once SDK PRs are merged and the deprecation alias is removed.
